d:
Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient
ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead
of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat
them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.
Welcome to the official YouTube home of Mr Bean, the legendary comedy icon loved across the globe! Step into a world of hilarious mishaps, quirky problem-solving, and unforgettable moments that have entertained generations.
